reason: I already paste my questions into ChatGPT for free and my broker is rolling out its own AI stuff, so I don't see why I'd pay a monthly fee and move my money to some partner broker I've never heard of. Putting in a few hundred every payday by hand takes me five minutes.
objection: With under $20k invested, any monthly fee eats a real chunk of my returns, and I'd be handing my actual money to a new app with a cartoon pet and an unnamed broker when the AI I already use is free.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged into the broker I already use and cost a couple of bucks a month, and after a few months of demo money it clearly did better than my own payday routine.
